text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That tasted pretty good, didn't it?
Food tastings aren't bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Still, when I think of how delicious these veggies are... If I study them more, maybe I can cook even tastier dishes... right!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Cook and cook,
and make it even more buono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's make a whole bunch, everyone!
